title: Hosford Exhibits in ‘All Works Square’
paragraphs: Hosford took Honorable Mention for “Brewster Herring Run”

Guild of Harwich Artist, Peggy Masce Hosford took Honorable Mention for her painting, “Brewster Herring Run” in the “All Works Square” Exhibit at the Creative Arts Center, 154 Crowell Rd., Chatham. The juried show was open to all, both Members and Non-members in all mediums. Paintings had to be framed and matted in a square format.
“All Works Square” runs until Thursday, May 24, 2018 4:00 PM

pwsbuilder May 17, 2018

Guild of Harwich Artist, Peggy Masce Hosford took Honorable Mention for her painting, “Brewster Herring Run” in the “All Works Square” Exhibit at the Creative Arts Center, 154 Crowell Rd., Chatham. The juried show was open to all, both Members and Non-members in all mediums. Paintings had to be framed and matted in a square format.

“All Works Square” runs until Thursday, May 24, 2018 4:00 PM
